documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27 with revenue from operations at INR 121 crores, marking a 60% year-on-year growth driven by robust consumer demand and higher jewellery sales. EBITDA grew 39% year-on-year to INR 18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while Profit After Tax came in at INR 9 crores (7.5% margin). Management outlined active retail expansion plans with the launch of the Surat store scheduled for Q2 and three additional stores (Rajkot, Maninagar, Gandhinagar) slated for Q3. The company is strategically progressing towards hedging its inventory through Gold Metal Loans over a three-year period and aims for an equal B2B and retail revenue mix in a year or two, shifting to a 75:25 retail-heavy mix in the long term. RBZ Jewellers reported its operational and financial results for Q1 FY27, highlighting a year-on-year revenue increase of approximately 60% driven by customer demand and higher jewellery sales.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is expected to reach 50-50 in a year or two.
guidance.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the long-term revenue mix will be 75% retail and 25% B2B.
guidance.quote: and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Management stated that by the end of this financial year, the debt-to-equity ratio will still remain below 1:1 at around 0.8 to 1.
guidance.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

guidance.claim: Management stated a target for maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

guidance.claim: RBZ Jewellers did not provide explicit forward financial guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IIJS response has been warm, encouraging, and characterized by buyer growth and good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that July and August order kitties are full due to good appreciation of designs from the corporate end.
demand_outlook.quote: because of which the July, August order kitty are full. So right now, company is very much in line with the orders that we are receiving, and I hope that the response continues further.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for Q2 looks good and promising.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: The retail business comprises approximately 65% occasion wear and 35% daily wear on average.
demand_outlook.quote: The retail business comprises approximately 65% occasion wear and 35% daily wear on average.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: In retail sales, daily wear represents approximately 35% of consumption while occasion wear accounts for 65%.
demand_outlook.quote: The consumption is approximately 35% of daily wear and 65% of occasion wear.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced that the Surat store will launch in Quarter 2.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet with an inventory deployment of INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that small format stores have an inventory deployment of around INR 50 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that approximately INR 10 crores of capex is incurred for the Surat store.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion includes flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3).
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to expand its retail footprint with new showrooms in Surat and Rajkot targeted to open by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring strategic locations for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: A typical large-format retail showroom for the company requires an inventory of approximately INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: A typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that revenue from operations stood at INR 121 crores, representing a 60% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA for the quarter was INR 18 crores with EBITDA margins at a healthy 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that Profit After Tax for the quarter was INR 9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the amortization of lease assets is INR 76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was reported at 14.9%.
Full-year EBITDA margin for FY26 improved by 233 basis points year-on-year to 14.44%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: RBZ Jewellers earns gross margins of around 12% to 14% in retail and 7% to 8% in wholesale.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, retail would be around 12% or 14% GP. Wholesale will be around 7% to 8% GP.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the total factory capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that factory capacity utilization is running at around 50% during non-season times.
orders_capacity.quote: And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization goes to 75% to 85% minimum during core season times.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: The wholesale segment has presence in 72+ cities across 20 states, serving marquee clients including Titan, Malabar Gold, and Senco Gold.
orders_capacity.quote: Presence in 72+ cities across 20 states, serving marquee clients including Titan, Malabar Gold, and Senco Gold.

orders_capacity.claim: Job work services accounted for 52% of total gold volumes sold in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Accounted for 52% of total gold volumes sold in FY26, highlighting its strategic importance to the business.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's manufacturing facility capacity utilization is currently around 50% to 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: During Q4 FY26, RBZ Jewellers launched 730 new designs, averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming in this financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated an intention to gradually transition inventory to be completely hedged using Gold Metal Loans over a three-year period.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started using GML in this quarter, a little bit, but as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

capital_allocation.claim: Job work services enables an asset-light business model by minimizing investment in gold inventory while supporting demand fulfillment.
capital_allocation.quote: Enables an asset-light business model by minimizing investment in gold inventory while supporting demand fulfillment.

capital_allocation.claim: Management targets keeping debt levels around a 1:1 ratio, reaching approximately 1:1.2 at peak debt for its upcoming store expansions.
capital_allocation.quote: We want to stay -- we want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5. But generally, right now, I think for these 4 showrooms, it will be around 1:1.2 at peak debt, at least for this fiscal year that I am understanding.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to explore Gold Metal Loans (GML) in FY27 to purchase gold for new store additions.
capital_allocation.quote: So we will be exploring GML in this financial year perhaps for buying -- the new buying of gold that will happen for the upcoming stores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that average gold rates remained stagnant, resulting in negligible inventory gains in the system for Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that recent customs duty and authorization restrictions on gold imports are not advantageous, though ground-level impacts are being monitored.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Surat store will launch in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Maninagar and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the capex break-even for the new stores to be achieved in a year or less.
management_commitments.quote: the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a 50-50 B2B to B2C revenue mix in a year or two.
management_commitments.quote: the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that 18-carat corporate sales mix will reach at least 20% by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that churning over the whole inventory to go hedged via GML will take three years.
management_commitments.quote: we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: RBZ Jewellers aims to commence operations of its new showrooms in Surat and Rajkot by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to have 4 retail stores operating in this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We are going to have, let's say, 4 stores in this calendar year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
